metas.name: 100 Years
metas.description: 100 Years is an "upcoming" science fiction film written by John Malkovich and directed by Robert Rodriguez. Advertised in 2015 with the tagline "The Movie You Will Never See", it is due to be released on November 18, 2115.  Pending release, the film is being kept in a high-tech safe behind bulletproof glass that will open automatically on November 18, 2115, the day of the film's premiere. One thousand guests from around the world, including Malkovich and Rodriguez, have received a pair of invitation tickets made of metal for the premiere, which they can hand down to their descendants.

metas.name: Gigantic
metas.description: Set in Spain during the Age of Exploration, Disney’s “Gigantic” follows adventure-seeker Jack as he discovers a world of giants hidden within the clouds. He hatches a grand plan with Inma, a 60-foot-tall, 11-year-old girl, and agrees to help her find her way home. But he doesn’t account for her super-sized personality—and who knew giants were so down to earth?

metas.name: Flipside
metas.description: Blayke and Charlotte are best friends, they make plans to go to college together and to share an apartment. But sometimes things don't end up the way you plan and the person you need in your life, chooses a different path.

metas.name: The Last Mourning: End of the Cycle
The Celestials
metas.description: After Earth is overrun by a demon goddess, eight high-school criminals must merge souls with ancient celestial warriors to stop a cosmic extinction, proving they are more than the 'trash' the world labeled them.

metas.name: Shadow Part Three: God Mode
metas.description: In 2055, Tamil Nadu's government launches a controversial cloning program using alien DNA to rebuild its military power. Former investigator Vetri, part human and part AI, discovers that the project's neural link is connected to his own consciousness from the defunct War Switch network. When clones across Earth begin awakening as one mind and alien ships reappear above orbit, Vetri must stop the God Mode Protocol-a fusion of cloning, AI, and extraterrestrial intelligence that could erase individuality forever. Caught between corrupt Tamil Nadu politicians, his former mentor Captain Raghavan, and the alien collective claiming to be humanity's evolution, Vetri must battle his own cloned duplicates and confront what it truly means to be human. Set across space stations, alien ruins, and Chennai's political corridors, Shadow Part 3 - God Mode (2055) is a visionary conclusion to the Shadow Trilogy-blending action, emotion, and philosophy in a war that transcends species, identity, and reality.
